title: Webinar video available
summary: Our Nov. 12, 2020 webinar demonstrated the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal and presented recent updates to the CMDKP.
bodyHtml: In our November 12, 2020 webinar Dr. Douglas Kiel discussed the motivation for the recent collaboration between the Broad Institute Knowledge Portal team and the International Federation of Musculoskeletal Research Societies (IFMRS) to create the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSK-KP). We then demonstrated the MSK-KP and also presented recent updates to the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal.
